zh: 多用户与会话管理全面升级：支持多端/跨标签页会话实时同步与统一账号登出拦截，隔离租户级与账号级侧栏偏好设置，重登弹窗与过期跳转体验更平滑。
前端首页与平台架构模块化重构：拆分为轻量化 home-shell 与 home-tools 核心，移除冗余历史双套布局，设置中心与业务弹窗按需加载提升首屏加载性能。
完善平台级服务与诊断生命周期：平台告警、服务自检与内置工具比对支持无 DOM 依赖的标准化事件总线与后台轮询守护。
en: Upgraded multi-user session lifecycle: seamless cross-tab synchronization, scoped tenant/account preference isolation, graceful re-login prompts, and clean logout handling.
Modular frontend architecture refactoring: decoupled into home-shell and home-tools cores, eliminated legacy dual-layout runtime overhead, and enabled on-demand settings loading.
Hardened platform diagnostics and alerts: standardized event bus and background lifecycle guards for health probes, alerts, and tool updates without DOM dependencies.
